design: Heavy-set middle-aged archivist with a broad low skull, blunt wide mandibles and short thick dreadlocks around neck. Carries a wooden-bronze record tray containing three sealed stubby archive canisters, held carefully with both hands. Ochre scales, firm even-footed stance.
